<h1 id="immich">Immich v3.4.0-rc.0</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.

Immich API

Base URLs:

* <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/api">https://raw.githubusercontent.com/api</a>

# Authentication

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer

* API Key (cookie)
    - Parameter Name: **immich_access_token**, in: cookie.

* API Key (api_key)
    - Parameter Name: **x-api-key**, in: header.

<h1 id="immich-activities">Activities</h1>

An activity is a like or a comment made by a user on an asset or album.

## List all activities

<a id="opIdgetActivities"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:2283/api/activities?albumId=497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /activities`

Returns a list of activities for the selected asset or album. The activities are returned in sorted order, with the oldest activities appearing first.

<h3 id="list-all-activities-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|albumId|query|string(uuid)|true|Album ID|
|assetId|query|string(uuid)|false|Asset ID (if activity is for an asset)|
|level|query|[ReactionLevel](#schemareactionlevel)|false|none|
|type|query|[ReactionType](#schemareactiontype)|false|none|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter by user ID|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|level|album|
|level|asset|
|type|comment|
|type|like|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "assetId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "comment": "string",
    "createdAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "type": "comment",
    "user": {
      "avatarColor": "primary",
      "email": "user@example.com",
      "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "name": "string",
      "profileChangedAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "profileImagePath": "string"
    }
  }
]
```

<h3 id="list-all-activities-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="list-all-activities-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[ActivityResponseDto](#schemaactivityresponsedto)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Create an activity

<a id="opIdcreateActivity"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/activities \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "albumId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "assetId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "comment": "string",
    "type": "comment"
  }'
```

`POST /activities`

Create a like or a comment for an album, or an asset in an album.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "albumId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "assetId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "comment": "string",
  "type": "comment"
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-activity-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[ActivityCreateDto](#schemaactivitycreatedto)|true|none|
|» albumId|body|string(uuid)|true|Album ID|
|» assetId|body|string(uuid)|false|Asset ID (if activity is for an asset)|
|» comment|body|string|false|Comment text (required if type is comment)|
|» type|body|[ReactionType](#schemareactiontype)|true|Reaction type|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|comment|
|» type|like|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "assetId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "comment": "string",
  "createdAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "type": "comment",
  "user": {
    "avatarColor": "primary",
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "name": "string",
    "profileChangedAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "profileImagePath": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-activity-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created||[ActivityResponseDto](#schemaactivityresponsedto)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Retrieve activity statistics

<a id="opIdgetActivityStatistics"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:2283/api/activities/statistics?albumId=497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /activities/statistics`

Returns the number of likes and comments for a given album or asset in an album.

<h3 id="retrieve-activity-statistics-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|albumId|query|string(uuid)|true|Album ID|
|assetId|query|string(uuid)|false|Asset ID (if activity is for an asset)|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "comments": 0,
  "likes": 0
}
```

<h3 id="retrieve-activity-statistics-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[ActivityStatisticsResponseDto](#schemaactivitystatisticsresponsedto)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Delete an activity

<a id="opIddeleteActivity"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/activities/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /activities/{id}`

Removes a like or comment from a given album or asset in an album.

<h3 id="delete-an-activity-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|none|

|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content||None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

<h1 id="immich-albums">Albums</h1>

An album is a collection of assets that can be shared with other users or via shared links.

## List all albums

<a id="opIdgetAllAlbums"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/albums \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /albums`

Retrieve a list of albums available to the authenticated user.

<h3 id="list-all-albums-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assetId|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter albums containing this asset ID (ignores other parameters)|
|id|query|string(uuid)|false|Album ID|
|isOwned|query|boolean|false|Filter by ownership: true = only owned, false = only shared-with-me, undefined = no filter|
|isShared|query|boolean|false|Filter by shared status: true = only shared, false = not shared, undefined = no filter|
|name|query|string|false|Album name (exact match)|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "albumName": "string",
    "albumThumbnailAssetId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "albumUsers": [
      {
        "role": "editor",
        "user": {
          "avatarColor": "primary",
          "email": "user@example.com",
          "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
          "name": "string",
          "profileChangedAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
          "profileImagePath": "string"
        }
      }
    ],
    "assetCount": 0,
    "contributorCounts": [
      {
        "assetCount": 0,
        "userId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
      }
    ],
    "createdAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "description": "string",
    "endDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "hasSharedLink": true,
    "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "isActivityEnabled": true,
    "lastModifiedAssetTimestamp": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "order": "asc",
    "shared": true,
    "startDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "updatedAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="list-all-albums-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="list-all-albums-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[AlbumResponseDto](#schemaalbumresponsedto)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Create an album

<a id="opIdcreateAlbum"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/albums \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "albumName": "string",
    "albumUsers": [
      {
        "role": "editor",
        "userId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
      }
    ],
    "assetIds": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ],
    "description": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /albums`

Create a new album. The album can also be created with initial users and assets.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "albumName": "string",
  "albumUsers": [
    {
      "role": "editor",
      "userId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    }
  ],
  "assetIds": [
    "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  ],
  "description": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-album-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateAlbumDto](#schemacreatealbumdto)|true|none|
|» albumName|body|string|true|Album name|
|» albumUsers|body|[[AlbumUserCreateDto](#schemaalbumusercreatedto)]|false|Album users|
|» assetIds|body|[string(uuid)]|false|Initial asset IDs|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Album description|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
  "description": "string",
  "endDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
```

## Add assets to albums

<a id="opIdaddAssetsToAlbums"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/albums/assets \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "albumIds": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ],
    "assetIds": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /albums/assets`

Send a list of asset IDs and album IDs to add each asset to each album.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "albumIds": [
    "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  ],
  "assetIds": [
    "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="add-assets-to-albums-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[AlbumsAddAssetsDto](#schemaalbumsaddassetsdto)|true|none|
|» albumIds|body|[string(uuid)]|true|Album IDs|
|» assetIds|body|[string(uuid)]|true|Asset IDs|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "error": "duplicate",
  "success": true
}
```

<h3 id="add-assets-to-albums-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[AlbumsAddAssetsResponseDto](#schemaalbumsaddassetsresponsedto)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Delete an album

<a id="opIddeleteAlbum"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/albums/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /albums/{id}`

Delete a specific album by its ID. Note the album is initially trashed and then immediately scheduled for deletion, but relies on a background job to complete the process.

<h3 id="delete-an-album-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|none|

<h3 id="delete-an-album-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content||None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Update an album

<a id="opIdupdateAlbumInfo"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/albums/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "albumName": "string",
    "albumThumbnailAssetId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "description": "string",
    "isActivityEnabled": true,
    "order": "asc"
  }'
```

`PATCH /albums/{id}`

Update the information of a specific album by its ID. This endpoint can be used to update the album name, description, sort order, etc. However, it is not used to add or remove assets or users from the album.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "albumName": "string",
  "albumThumbnailAssetId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "description": "string",
  "isActivityEnabled": true,
  "order": "asc"
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-album-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|none|
|body|body|[UpdateAlbumDto](#schemaupdatealbumdto)|true|none|
|» albumName|body|string|false|Album name|
|» albumThumbnailAssetId|body|string(uuid)|false|Album thumbnail asset ID|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Album description|
|» isActivityEnabled|body|boolean|false|Enable activity feed|
|» order|body|[AssetOrder](#schemaassetorder)|false|Asset sort order|

#### Enumerated Values

|---|---|
|» order|asc|
|» order|desc|

## Add assets to an album

<a id="opIdaddAssetsToAlbum"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/albums/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/assets \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "ids": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /albums/{id}/assets`

Add multiple assets to a specific album by its ID.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "ids": [
    "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="add-assets-to-an-album-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|none|
|body|body|[BulkIdsDto](#schemabulkidsdto)|true|none|
|» ids|body|[string(uuid)]|true|IDs to process|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "error": "duplicate",
    "errorMessage": "string",
    "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "success": true
  }
]
```

<h3 id="add-assets-to-an-album-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="add-assets-to-an-album-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[BulkIdResponseDto](#schemabulkidresponsedto)]|false|none|none|

<h1 id="immich-assets">Assets</h1>

An asset is an image or video that has been uploaded to Immich.

## Update assets

<a id="opIdupdateAssets"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/assets \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "dateTimeOriginal": "string",
    "dateTimeRelative": -9007199254740000,
    "description": "string",
    "duplicateId": "string",
    "ids": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ],
    "isFavorite": true,
    "latitude": -90,
    "longitude": -180,
    "rating": -1,
    "timeZone": "string",
    "visibility": "archive"
  }'
```

`PUT /assets`

Updates multiple assets at the same time.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "dateTimeOriginal": "string",
  "dateTimeRelative": -9007199254740000,
  "description": "string",
  "duplicateId": "string",
  "ids": [
    "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  ],
  "isFavorite": true,
  "latitude": -90,
  "longitude": -180,
  "rating": -1,
  "timeZone": "string",
  "visibility": "archive"
}
```

<h3 id="update-assets-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[AssetBulkUpdateDto](#schemaassetbulkupdatedto)|true|none|
|» dateTimeOriginal|body|string|false|Original date and time|
|» dateTimeRelative|body|integer|false|Relative time offset in minutes|
|» description|body|string|false|Asset description|
|» duplicateId|body|string \| null|false|Duplicate ID|
|» ids|body|[string(uuid)]|true|Asset IDs to update|
|» isFavorite|body|boolean|false|Mark as favorite|
|» latitude|body|number(double)|false|Latitude coordinate|
|» longitude|body|number(double)|false|Longitude coordinate|
|» rating|body|integer \| null|false|Rating in range [1-5] (starred), -1 (rejected), or null (unrated)|
|» timeZone|body|string|false|Time zone (IANA timezone)|
|» visibility|body|[AssetVisibility](#schemaassetvisibility)|false|Asset visibility|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» visibility|archive|
|» visibility|timeline|
|» visibility|hidden|
|» visibility|locked|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content||None|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Upload asset

<a id="opIduploadAsset"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/assets \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -F 'assetData=@/path/to/file' \
  -F 'duration=0' \
  -F 'fileCreatedAt=2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' \
  -F 'fileModifiedAt=2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' \
  -F 'filename=string' \
  -F 'isFavorite=true' \
  -F 'livePhotoVideoId=497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08' \
  -F 'metadata=[{"key":"string","value":{"property1":null,"property2":null}}]' \
  -F 'sidecarData=@/path/to/file' \
  -F 'visibility=archive'
```

`POST /assets`

Uploads a new asset to the server.

> Body parameter

```yaml
assetData: string
duration: 0
fileCreatedAt: "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
fileModifiedAt: "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
filename: string
isFavorite: true
livePhotoVideoId: "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
metadata:
  -
    key: string
    value:
      property1: null
      property2: null
sidecarData: string
visibility: archive
```

<h3 id="upload-asset-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|key|query|string|false|none|
|slug|query|string|false|none|
|x-immich-checksum|header|string|false|sha1 checksum that can be used for duplicate detection before the file is uploaded|
|body|body|[AssetMediaCreateDto](#schemaassetmediacreatedto)|true|Asset Upload Information|
|» assetData|body|string(binary)|true|Asset file data|
|» duration|body|integer|false|Duration in milliseconds (for videos)|
|» fileCreatedAt|body|string(date-time)|true|File creation date|
|» fileModifiedAt|body|string(date-time)|true|File modification date|
|» filename|body|string|false|Filename|
|» isFavorite|body|boolean|false|Mark as favorite|
|» livePhotoVideoId|body|string(uuid)|false|Live photo video ID|
|» metadata|body|[[AssetMetadataUpsertItemDto](#schemaassetmetadataupsertitemdto)]|false|Asset metadata items|
|» sidecarData|body|string(binary)|false|Sidecar file data|
|» visibility|body|[AssetVisibility](#schemaassetvisibility)|false|Asset visibility|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» visibility|archive|
|» visibility|timeline|
|» visibility|hidden|
|» visibility|locked|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "status": "created"
}
```

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "status": "created"
}
```

<h3 id="upload-asset-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Asset is a duplicate|[AssetMediaResponseDto](#schemaassetmediaresponsedto)|
|201|Created|Asset uploaded successfully|[AssetMediaResponseDto](#schemaassetmediaresponsedto)|

<aside class="warning">

bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Update an asset

<a id="opIdupdateAsset"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/assets/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "dateTimeOriginal": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "isFavorite": true,
    "latitude": -90,
    "livePhotoVideoId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "longitude": -180,
    "rating": -1,
    "visibility": "archive"
  }'
```

`PUT /assets/{id}`

Update information of a specific asset.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "dateTimeOriginal": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "isFavorite": true,
  "latitude": -90,
  "livePhotoVideoId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "longitude": -180,
  "rating": -1,
  "visibility": "archive"
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-asset-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|none|
|body|body|[UpdateAssetDto](#schemaupdateassetdto)|true|none|
|» dateTimeOriginal|body|string|false|Original date and time|
|» description|body|string|false|Asset description|
|» isFavorite|body|boolean|false|Mark as favorite|
|» latitude|body|number(double)|false|Latitude coordinate|
|» livePhotoVideoId|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Live photo video ID|
|» longitude|body|number(double)|false|Longitude coordinate|
|» rating|body|integer \| null|false|Rating in range [1-5] (starred), -1 (rejected), or null (unrated)|
|» visibility|body|[AssetVisibility](#schemaassetvisibility)|false|Asset visibility|

|---|---|

## Retrieve edits for an existing asset

<a id="opIdgetAssetEdits"></a>

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/assets/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/edits \

  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

```json
      "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",

        "width": 1,
        "x": 0,
        "y": 0
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Apply edits to an existing asset

<a id="opIdeditAsset"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/assets/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/edits \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "edits": [
      {
        "action": "crop",
        "parameters": {
          "height": 1,
          "width": 1,
          "x": 0,
          "y": 0
        }
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /assets/{id}/edits`

Apply a series of edit actions (crop, rotate, mirror) to the specified asset.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "edits": [
    {
      "action": "crop",
      "parameters": {
        "height": 1,
        "width": 1,
        "x": 0,
        "y": 0
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

|body|body|[AssetEditsCreateDto](#schemaasseteditscreatedto)|true|none|
|» edits|body|[[AssetEditActionItemDto](#schemaasseteditactionitemdto)]|true|List of edit actions to apply (crop, rotate, or mirror)|

> 200 Response

```json
  "assetId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "edits": [
    {
      "action": "crop",
      "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "parameters": {
        "height": 1,
        "width": 1,

        "y": 0
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Search asset files

`GET /asset-files`

|Parameter|Value|

|type|preview|
|type|thumbnail|
|type|sidecar|
|type|encoded_video|

```json
    "isEdited": true,
    "isProgressive": true,
    "isTransparent": true,
    "path": "string",
    "type": "fullsize",
    "updatedAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
  }
]
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[AssetFileResponseDto](#schemaassetfileresponsedto)]|false|none|none|

<h1 id="immich-database-backups-admin">Database Backups (admin)</h1>

Manage backups of the Immich database.

## List database backups

<a id="opIdlistDatabaseBackups"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/admin/database-backups \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /admin/database-backups`

Get the list of the successful and failed backups

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "backups": [
    {
      "filename": "string",
      "filesize": -9007199254740000,
      "timezone": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="list-database-backups-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[DatabaseBackupListResponseDto](#schemadatabasebackuplistresponsedto)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Delete database backup

<a id="opIddeleteDatabaseBackup"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/admin/database-backups \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "backups": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`DELETE /admin/database-backups`

Delete a backup by its filename

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "backups": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="delete-database-backup-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[DatabaseBackupDeleteDto](#schemadatabasebackupdeletedto)|true|none|
|» backups|body|[string]|true|Backup filenames to delete|

<h3 id="delete-database-backup-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Start database backup restore flow

<a id="opIdstartDatabaseRestoreFlow"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/admin/database-backups/start-restore \
  -X POST
```

`POST /admin/database-backups/start-restore`

Put Immich into maintenance mode to restore a backup (Immich must not be configured)

<h3 id="start-database-backup-restore-flow-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created||None|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Upload database backup

<a id="opIduploadDatabaseBackup"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/admin/database-backups/upload \
  -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -F 'file=@/path/to/file'
```

`POST /admin/database-backups/upload`

Uploads .sql/.sql.gz file to restore backup from

> Body parameter

```yaml
file: string
```

<h3 id="upload-database-backup-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[DatabaseBackupUploadDto](#schemadatabasebackupuploaddto)|true|Backup Upload|
|» file|body|string(binary)|false|Database backup file|

<h3 id="upload-database-backup-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created||None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

<h1 id="immich-download">Download</h1>

Endpoints for downloading assets or collections of assets.

## Download asset archive

<a id="opIddownloadArchive"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/download/archive \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "archiveName": "string",
    "assetIds": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ],
    "edited": true
  }'
```

`POST /download/archive`

Download a ZIP archive containing the specified assets. The assets must have been previously requested via the "getDownloadInfo" endpoint.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "archiveName": "string",
  "assetIds": [
    "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  ],
  "edited": true
}
```

<h3 id="download-asset-archive-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|key|query|string|false|none|
|slug|query|string|false|none|
|body|body|[DownloadArchiveDto](#schemadownloadarchivedto)|true|none|
|» archiveName|body|string|false|The name of the archive to download, without extension|
|» assetIds|body|[string(uuid)]|true|Asset IDs|
|» edited|body|boolean|false|Download edited asset if available|

<h3 id="download-asset-archive-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Retrieve download information

<a id="opIdgetDownloadInfo"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/download/info \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "albumId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "archiveSize": 1,
    "assetIds": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ],
    "userId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  }'
```

`POST /download/info`

Retrieve information about how to request a download for the specified assets or album. The response includes groups of assets that can be downloaded together.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "albumId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "archiveSize": 1,
  "assetIds": [
    "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  ],
  "userId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

<h3 id="retrieve-download-information-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|key|query|string|false|none|
|slug|query|string|false|none|
|body|body|[DownloadInfoDto](#schemadownloadinfodto)|true|none|
|» albumId|body|string(uuid)|false|Album ID to download|
|» archiveSize|body|integer|false|Archive size limit in bytes|
|» assetIds|body|[string(uuid)]|false|Asset IDs to download|
|» userId|body|string(uuid)|false|User ID to download assets from|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "archives": [
    {
      "assetIds": [
        "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
      ],
      "size": -9007199254740000
    }
  ],
  "totalSize": -9007199254740000
}
```

<h3 id="retrieve-download-information-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created||[DownloadResponseDto](#schemadownloadresponsedto)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Resolve duplicate groups

<a id="opIdresolveDuplicates"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/duplicates/resolve \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "groups": [
      {
        "duplicateId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
        "keepAssetIds": [
          "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
        ],
        "trashAssetIds": [
          "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
        ]
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /duplicates/resolve`

Resolve duplicate groups by synchronizing metadata across assets and deleting/trashing duplicates.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "groups": [
    {
      "duplicateId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "keepAssetIds": [
        "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
      ],
      "trashAssetIds": [
        "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

<h1 id="immich-faces">Faces</h1>

A face is a detected human face within an asset, which can be associated with a person. Faces are normally detected via machine learning, but can also be created manually.

## Retrieve faces for asset

<a id="opIdgetFaces"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:2283/api/faces?id=497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

## Create a face

<a id="opIdcreateFace"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/faces \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "assetId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "height": -9007199254740000,
    "imageHeight": -9007199254740000,
    "imageWidth": -9007199254740000,
    "personId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "userId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "width": -9007199254740000,
    "x": -9007199254740000,
    "y": -9007199254740000
  }'
```

`POST /faces`

Create a new face that has not been discovered by facial recognition. The content of the bounding box is considered a face.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "assetId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "height": -9007199254740000,
  "imageHeight": -9007199254740000,
  "imageWidth": -9007199254740000,
  "personId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "userId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "width": -9007199254740000,
  "x": -9007199254740000,
  "y": -9007199254740000
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-face-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[AssetFaceCreateDto](#schemaassetfacecreatedto)|true|none|
|» assetId|body|string(uuid)|true|Asset ID|
|» height|body|integer|true|Face bounding box height|
|» imageHeight|body|integer|true|Image height in pixels|
|» imageWidth|body|integer|true|Image width in pixels|
|» personId|body|string(uuid)|true|Person ID|
|» userId|body|string(uuid)|false|User ID|
|» width|body|integer|true|Face bounding box width|
|» x|body|integer|true|Face bounding box X coordinate|
|» y|body|integer|true|Face bounding box Y coordinate|

<h3 id="create-a-face-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created||None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

<h1 id="immich-libraries">Libraries</h1>

An external library is made up of input file paths or expressions that are scanned for asset files. Discovered files are automatically imported. Assets much be unique within a library, but can be duplicated across libraries. Each user has a default upload library, and can have one or more external libraries.

<a id="opIdgetAllLibraries"></a>

<h1 id="immich-map">Map</h1>

Map endpoints include supplemental functionality related to geolocation, such as reverse geocoding and retrieving map markers for assets with geolocation data.

## Retrieve map markers

<a id="opIdgetMapMarkers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/map/markers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /map/markers`

Retrieve a list of latitude and longitude coordinates for every asset with location data.

<h3 id="retrieve-map-markers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|fileCreatedAfter|query|string(date-time)|false|Filter assets created after this date|
|fileCreatedBefore|query|string(date-time)|false|Filter assets created before this date|
|isArchived|query|boolean|false|Filter by archived status|
|isFavorite|query|boolean|false|Filter by favorite status|
|withPartners|query|boolean|false|Include partner assets|
|withSharedAlbums|query|boolean|false|Include shared album assets|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "city": "string",
    "country": "string",
    "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "lat": 0,
    "lon": 0,
    "state": "string"
  }
]
```

|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h1 id="immich-memories">Memories</h1>

A memory is a specialized collection of assets with dedicated viewing implementations in the web and mobile clients. A memory includes fields related to visibility and are automatically generated per user via a background job.

## Retrieve memories

<a id="opIdsearchMemories"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/memories \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /memories`

Retrieve a list of memories. Memories are sorted descending by creation date by default, although they can also be sorted in ascending order, or randomly.

<h3 id="retrieve-memories-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|for|query|string(date)|false|Filter by date|
|id|query|string(uuid)|false|Memory ID|
|isSaved|query|boolean|false|Filter by saved status|
|isTrashed|query|boolean|false|Include trashed memories|
|isUpcoming|query|boolean|false|Filter by memories that have not been shown yet|
|order|query|[MemorySearchOrder](#schemamemorysearchorder)|false|none|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number|
|size|query|integer|false|Number of memories to return|
|type|query|[MemoryType](#schemamemorytype)|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|order|asc|
|order|desc|
|order|random|
|type|on_this_day|
|type|birthday|

## Create a memory

<a id="opIdcreateMemory"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/memories \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "assetIds": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ],
    "data": {
      "personId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "personName": "string",
      "year": 1000
    },
    "hideAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "isSaved": true,
    "memoryAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "seenAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "showAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "type": "on_this_day"
  }'
```

`POST /memories`

Create a new memory by providing a name, description, and a list of asset IDs to include in the memory.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "assetIds": [
    "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  ],
  "data": {
    "personId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",

    "year": 1000
  },
  "hideAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "isSaved": true,
  "memoryAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "seenAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "showAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "type": "on_this_day"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-memory-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[MemoryCreateDto](#schemamemorycreatedto)|true|none|
|» assetIds|body|[string(uuid)]|false|Asset IDs to associate with memory|
|» data|body|[MemoryDataDto](#schemamemorydatadto)|true|none|
|» hideAt|body|string(date-time)|false|Date when memory should be hidden|
|» isSaved|body|boolean|false|Is memory saved|
|» memoryAt|body|string(date-time)|true|Memory date|
|» seenAt|body|string(date-time)|false|Date when memory was seen|
|» showAt|body|string(date-time)|false|Date when memory should be shown|
|» type|body|[MemoryType](#schemamemorytype)|true|Memory type|

|---|---|

|» type|birthday|

<h1 id="immich-notifications">Notifications</h1>

A notification is a specialized message sent to users to inform them of important events. Currently, these notifications are only shown in the Immich web application.

## Retrieve notifications

<a id="opIdgetNotifications"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/notifications \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /notifications`

Retrieve a list of notifications.

<h3 id="retrieve-notifications-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter by notification ID|
|level|query|[NotificationLevel](#schemanotificationlevel)|false|none|
|type|query|[NotificationType](#schemanotificationtype)|false|none|
|unread|query|boolean|false|Filter by unread status|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|level|success|
|level|error|
|level|warning|
|level|info|
|type|JobFailed|
|type|BackupFailed|
|type|SystemMessage|
|type|AlbumInvite|
|type|AlbumUpdate|
|type|ClusterGroupRequest|
|type|Custom|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "createdAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "data": {
      "property1": null,
      "property2": null
    },
    "description": "string",
    "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "level": "success",
    "readAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "title": "string",
    "type": "JobFailed"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="retrieve-notifications-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="retrieve-notifications-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[NotificationDto](#schemanotificationdto)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Update notifications

<a id="opIdupdateNotifications"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/notifications \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "ids": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ],
    "readAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
  }'
```

`PUT /notifications`

Update a list of notifications. Allows to bulk-set the read status of notifications.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "ids": [
    "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  ],
  "readAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```

<h3 id="update-notifications-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[NotificationUpdateAllDto](#schemanotificationupdatealldto)|true|none|
|» ids|body|[string(uuid)]|true|Notification IDs to update|
|» readAt|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Date when notifications were read|

## Create a notification

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/admin/notifications \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \

  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "data": {
      "property1": null,
```

<h1 id="immich-people">People</h1>

A person is a collection of faces, which can be favorited and named. A person can also be merged into another person. People are automatically created via the face recognition job.

## Get all people

<a id="opIdgetAllPeople"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/people \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /people`

Retrieve a list of all people.

<h3 id="get-all-people-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|closestAssetId|query|string(uuid)|false|Closest asset ID for similarity search|
|closestPersonId|query|string(uuid)|false|Closest person ID for similarity search|
|isFavorite|query|boolean|false|Filter by favorite status|
|isHidden|query|boolean|false|Filter by hidden status|
|name|query|string|false|Filter by person name|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number for pagination|
|sharedById|query|string(uuid)|false|Only include people to which the user gave access|

`POST /people/merge`

Merge an ordered list of people together into a single person. The final name and birth date are always the first defined value, following the order. Also automatically merges people for other users in the cluster group, skipping people that would result in overriding a previously set name or birth date.

> Body parameter

## Search large assets

<a id="opIdsearchLargeAssets"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/search/large-assets \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /search/large-assets`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

Search for assets that are considered large based on specified criteria.

<h3 id="search-large-assets-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|albumIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by album IDs|
|city|query|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by city name|
|country|query|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by country name|
|createdAfter|query|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by creation date (after)|
|createdBefore|query|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by creation date (before)|
|isEncoded|query|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by encoded status|
|isFavorite|query|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by favorite status|
|isMotion|query|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by motion photo status|
|isNotInAlbum|query|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter assets not in any album|
|isOffline|query|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by offline status|
|lensModel|query|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by lens model|
|libraryId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Library ID to filter by|
|make|query|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by camera make|
|minFileSize|query|integer|false|Minimum file size in bytes|
|model|query|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by camera model|
|ocr|query|string|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by OCR text content|
|personIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by person IDs|
|rating|query|integer \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by rating [1-5], or null for unrated|
|size|query|integer|false|Number of results to return|
|state|query|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by state/province name|
|tagIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by tag IDs|
|takenAfter|query|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by taken date (after)|
|takenBefore|query|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by taken date (before)|
|trashedAfter|query|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by trash date (after)|
|trashedBefore|query|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by trash date (before)|
|type|query|[AssetTypeEnum](#schemaassettypeenum)|false|**Deprecated.**|
|updatedAfter|query|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by update date (after)|
|updatedBefore|query|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by update date (before)|
|visibility|query|[AssetVisibility](#schemaassetvisibility)|false|**Deprecated.**|
|withDeleted|query|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Include deleted assets|
|withExif|query|boolean|false|Include EXIF data in response|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|IMAGE|
|type|VIDEO|
|type|AUDIO|
|type|OTHER|
|visibility|archive|
|visibility|timeline|
|visibility|hidden|
|visibility|locked|

<h3 id="search-random-assets-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[RandomSearchDto](#schemarandomsearchdto)|true|none|
|» albumIds|body|[string(uuid)]|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by album IDs|
|» city|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by city name|
|» country|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by country name|
|» createdAfter|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by creation date (after)|
|» createdBefore|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by creation date (before)|
|» filter|body|[SearchFilter](#schemasearchfilter)|false|none|
|» isEncoded|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by encoded status|
|» isFavorite|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by favorite status|
|» isMotion|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by motion photo status|
|» isNotInAlbum|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter assets not in any album|
|» isOffline|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by offline status|
|» lensModel|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by lens model|
|» libraryId|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Library ID to filter by|
|» make|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by camera make|
|» model|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by camera model|
|» ocr|body|string|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by OCR text content|
|» personIds|body|[string(uuid)]|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by person IDs|
|» rating|body|integer \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by rating [1-5], or null for unrated|
|» size|body|integer|false|Number of results to return|
|» state|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by state/province name|
|» tagIds|body|[string(uuid)]|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by tag IDs|
|» takenAfter|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by taken date (after)|
|» takenBefore|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by taken date (before)|
|» trashedAfter|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by trash date (after)|
|» trashedBefore|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by trash date (before)|
|» type|body|[AssetTypeEnum](#schemaassettypeenum)|false|**Deprecated.** Asset type|
|» updatedAfter|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by update date (after)|
|» updatedBefore|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by update date (before)|
|» visibility|body|[AssetVisibility](#schemaassetvisibility)|false|**Deprecated.** Asset visibility|
|» withDeleted|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Include deleted assets|
|» withExif|body|boolean|false|Include EXIF data in response|
|» withPeople|body|boolean|false|Include people data in response|
|» withStacked|body|boolean|false|Include stacked assets|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|IMAGE|
|» type|VIDEO|
|» type|AUDIO|
|» type|OTHER|
|» visibility|archive|
|» visibility|timeline|
|» visibility|hidden|
|» visibility|locked|

<h3 id="smart-asset-search-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[SmartSearchDto](#schemasmartsearchdto)|true|none|
|» albumIds|body|[string(uuid)]|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by album IDs|
|» city|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by city name|
|» country|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by country name|
|» createdAfter|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by creation date (after)|
|» createdBefore|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by creation date (before)|
|» filter|body|[SearchFilter](#schemasearchfilter)|false|none|
|» isEncoded|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by encoded status|
|» isFavorite|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by favorite status|
|» isMotion|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by motion photo status|
|» isNotInAlbum|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter assets not in any album|
|» isOffline|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by offline status|
|» language|body|string|false|Search language code|
|» lensModel|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by lens model|
|» libraryId|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Library ID to filter by|
|» make|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by camera make|
|» model|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by camera model|
|» ocr|body|string|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by OCR text content|
|» page|body|integer|false|**Deprecated.** Page number|
|» personIds|body|[string(uuid)]|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by person IDs|
|» query|body|string|false|Natural language search query|
|» queryAssetId|body|string(uuid)|false|Asset ID to use as search reference|
|» rating|body|integer \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by rating [1-5], or null for unrated|
|» size|body|integer|false|Number of results to return|
|» state|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by state/province name|
|» tagIds|body|[string(uuid)]|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by tag IDs|
|» takenAfter|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by taken date (after)|
|» takenBefore|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by taken date (before)|
|» trashedAfter|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by trash date (after)|
|» trashedBefore|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by trash date (before)|
|» type|body|[AssetTypeEnum](#schemaassettypeenum)|false|**Deprecated.** Asset type|
|» updatedAfter|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by update date (after)|
|» updatedBefore|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by update date (before)|
|» visibility|body|[AssetVisibility](#schemaassetvisibility)|false|**Deprecated.** Asset visibility|
|» withDeleted|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Include deleted assets|
|» withExif|body|boolean|false|Include EXIF data in response|

|---|---|

|» type|VIDEO|

|» albumIds|body|[string(uuid)]|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by album IDs|
|» city|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by city name|
|» country|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by country name|
|» createdAfter|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by creation date (after)|
|» createdBefore|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by creation date (before)|
|» description|body|string|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by description text|
|» filter|body|[SearchFilter](#schemasearchfilter)|false|none|
|» isEncoded|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by encoded status|
|» isFavorite|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by favorite status|
|» isMotion|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by motion photo status|
|» isNotInAlbum|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter assets not in any album|
|» isOffline|body|boolean|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by offline status|
|» lensModel|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by lens model|
|» libraryId|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Library ID to filter by|
|» make|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by camera make|
|» model|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by camera model|
|» ocr|body|string|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by OCR text content|
|» personIds|body|[string(uuid)]|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by person IDs|
|» rating|body|integer \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by rating [1-5], or null for unrated|
|» state|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by state/province name|
|» tagIds|body|[string(uuid)]|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by tag IDs|
|» takenAfter|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by taken date (after)|
|» takenBefore|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by taken date (before)|
|» trashedAfter|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by trash date (after)|
|» trashedBefore|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by trash date (before)|
|» type|body|[AssetTypeEnum](#schemaassettypeenum)|false|**Deprecated.** Asset type|
|» updatedAfter|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by update date (after)|
|» updatedBefore|body|string(date-time)|false|**Deprecated.** Filter by update date (before)|
|» visibility|body|[AssetVisibility](#schemaassetvisibility)|false|**Deprecated.** Asset visibility|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|IMAGE|
|» type|VIDEO|
|» type|AUDIO|
|» type|OTHER|
|» visibility|archive|
|» visibility|timeline|
|» visibility|hidden|
|» visibility|locked|

## Retrieve search suggestions

<a id="opIdgetSearchSuggestions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:2283/api/search/suggestions?type=country' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /search/suggestions`

Retrieve search suggestions based on partial input. This endpoint is used for typeahead search features.

<h3 id="retrieve-search-suggestions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|country|query|string|false|Filter by country|
|includeNull|query|boolean|false|Include null values in suggestions|
|lensModel|query|string|false|Filter by lens model|
|make|query|string|false|Filter by camera make|
|model|query|string|false|Filter by camera model|
|state|query|string|false|Filter by state/province|
|type|query|[SearchSuggestionType](#schemasearchsuggestiontype)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|country|
|type|state|
|type|city|
|type|camera-make|
|type|camera-model|
|type|camera-lens-model|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  "string"
]
```

<h3 id="retrieve-search-suggestions-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="retrieve-search-suggestions-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[string]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Set server product key

<a id="opIdsetServerLicense"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/server/license \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "activationKey": "string",
    "licenseKey": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /server/license`

Validate and set the server product key if successful.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "activationKey": "string",
  "licenseKey": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="set-server-product-key-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[LicenseKeyDto](#schemalicensekeydto)|true|none|
|» activationKey|body|string|true|Activation key|
|» licenseKey|body|string|true|License key (format: /^IM(SV\|CL)(-[\dA-Za-z]{4}){8}$/)|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "activatedAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "activationKey": "string",
  "licenseKey": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="set-server-product-key-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[UserLicense](#schemauserlicense)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /server/version`

Retrieve the current server version in semantic versioning (semver) format.

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "featureLevel": 0,
  "major": 0,
  "minor": 0,
  "patch": 0,
  "prerelease": 0
}
```

<h3 id="get-server-version-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[ServerVersionResponseDto](#schemaserverversionresponsedto)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

<h1 id="immich-sessions">Sessions</h1>

A session represents an authenticated login session for a user. Sessions also appear in the web application as "Authorized devices".

## Retrieve sessions

<a id="opIdgetSessions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/sessions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /sessions`

Retrieve a list of sessions for the user.

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "appVersion": "string",
    "createdAt": "string",
    "current": true,
    "deviceOS": "string",
    "deviceType": "string",
    "expiresAt": "string",
    "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "isPendingSyncReset": true,
    "updatedAt": "string"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="retrieve-sessions-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|

<h3 id="retrieve-sessions-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[SessionResponseDto](#schemasessionresponsedto)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Create a session

<a id="opIdcreateSession"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/sessions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "deviceOS": "string",
    "deviceType": "string",
    "duration": 1
  }'
```

`POST /sessions`

Create a session as a child to the current session. This endpoint is used for casting.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "deviceOS": "string",
  "deviceType": "string",
  "duration": 1
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-session-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[SessionCreateDto](#schemasessioncreatedto)|true|none|
|» deviceOS|body|string|false|Device OS|
|» deviceType|body|string|false|Device type|
|» duration|body|integer|false|Session duration in seconds|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "appVersion": "string",
  "createdAt": "string",
  "current": true,
  "deviceOS": "string",
  "deviceType": "string",
  "expiresAt": "string",
  "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "isPendingSyncReset": true,
  "token": "string",
  "updatedAt": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-session-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created||[SessionCreateResponseDto](#schemasessioncreateresponsedto)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Delete all sessions

<a id="opIddeleteAllSessions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/sessions \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /sessions`

Delete all sessions for the user. This will not delete the current session.

<h3 id="delete-all-sessions-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content||None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

## Update a session

<a id="opIdupdateSession"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/sessions/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "isPendingSyncReset": true
  }'
```

`PUT /sessions/{id}`

Update a specific session identified by id.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "isPendingSyncReset": true
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|none|
|body|body|[SessionUpdateDto](#schemasessionupdatedto)|true|none|
|» isPendingSyncReset|body|boolean|false|Reset pending sync state|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "appVersion": "string",
  "createdAt": "string",
  "current": true,
  "deviceOS": "string",
  "deviceType": "string",
  "expiresAt": "string",
  "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "isPendingSyncReset": true,
  "updatedAt": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-session-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[SessionResponseDto](#schemasessionresponsedto)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearer, cookie, api_key
</aside>

<h1 id="immich-shared-links">Shared links</h1>

A shared link is a public url that provides access to a specific album, asset, or collection of assets. A shared link can be protected with a password, include a specific slug, allow or disallow downloads, and optionally include an expiration date.

## Retrieve all shared links

<a id="opIdgetAllSharedLinks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/shared-links \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

Retrieve a list of all shared links.

## Create a shared link

<a id="opIdcreateSharedLink"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/shared-links \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "albumId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "allowDownload": true,
    "allowUpload": true,
    "assetIds": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ],
    "description": "string",
    "expiresAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "password": "string",
    "showMetadata": true,
    "slug": "string",
    "type": "ALBUM"
  }'
```

`POST /shared-links`

Create a new shared link.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "albumId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "allowDownload": true,
  "allowUpload": true,
  "assetIds": [
    "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  ],
  "description": "string",
  "expiresAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "password": "string",
  "showMetadata": true,
  "slug": "string",
  "type": "ALBUM"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-shared-link-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[SharedLinkCreateDto](#schemasharedlinkcreatedto)|true|none|
|» albumId|body|string(uuid)|false|Album ID (for album sharing)|
|» allowDownload|body|boolean|false|Allow downloads|
|» allowUpload|body|boolean|false|Allow uploads|
|» assetIds|body|[string(uuid)]|false|Asset IDs (for individual assets)|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Link description|
|» expiresAt|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Expiration date|
|» password|body|string \| null|false|Link password|
|» showMetadata|body|boolean|false|Show metadata|
|» slug|body|string \| null|false|Custom URL slug|
|» type|body|[SharedLinkType](#schemasharedlinktype)|true|Shared link type|

|---|---|
|» type|ALBUM|
|» type|INDIVIDUAL|

<h1 id="immich-stacks">Stacks</h1>

A stack is a group of related assets. One asset is the "primary" asset, and the rest are "child" assets. On the main timeline, stack parents are included by default, while child assets are hidden.

## Retrieve stacks

<a id="opIdsearchStacks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/stacks \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

## Create a stack

<a id="opIdcreateStack"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/stacks \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "assetIds": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /stacks`

Create a new stack by providing a name and a list of asset IDs to include in the stack. If any of the provided asset IDs are primary assets of an existing stack, the existing stack will be merged into the newly created stack.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "assetIds": [
    "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  ]
}
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[StackCreateDto](#schemastackcreatedto)|true|none|
|» assetIds|body|[string(uuid)]|true|Asset IDs (first becomes primary, min 2)|

```bash
  -d '{
    "acks": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

```json
  "acks": [

}
```

</aside>

<h1 id="immich-timeline">Timeline</h1>

Specialized endpoints related to the timeline implementation used in the web application. External applications or tools should not use or rely on these endpoints, as they are subject to change without notice.

## Get time bucket

<a id="opIdgetTimeBucket"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:2283/api/timeline/bucket?timeBucket=2024-01-01T00%3A00%3A00.000Z' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /timeline/bucket`

Retrieve a string of all asset ids in a given time bucket.

<h3 id="get-time-bucket-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|albumId|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter assets belonging to a specific album|
|bbox|query|string|false|Bounding box coordinates as west,south,east,north (WGS84)|
|isFavorite|query|boolean|false|Filter by favorite status (true for favorites only, false for non-favorites only)|
|isTrashed|query|boolean|false|Filter by trash status (true for trashed assets only, false for non-trashed only)|
|key|query|string|false|none|
|order|query|[AssetOrder](#schemaassetorder)|false|Sort order for assets within time buckets (ASC for oldest first, DESC for newest first)|
|orderBy|query|[AssetOrderBy](#schemaassetorderby)|false|Date to group and order assets by (takenAt for date taken, createdAt for date added to Immich)|
|personId|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter assets containing a specific person (face recognition)|
|slug|query|string|false|none|
|tagId|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter assets with a specific tag|
|timeBucket|query|string|true|Time bucket identifier in YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00.000Z format|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter assets by specific user ID|
|visibility|query|[AssetVisibility](#schemaassetvisibility)|false|Filter by asset visibility status (ARCHIVE, TIMELINE, HIDDEN, LOCKED)|
|withCoordinates|query|boolean|false|Include location data in the response|
|withPartners|query|boolean|false|Include assets shared by partners|
|withStacked|query|boolean|false|Include stacked assets in the response. When true, only primary assets from stacks are returned.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|order|asc|
|order|desc|
|orderBy|takenAt|
|orderBy|createdAt|
|visibility|archive|
|visibility|timeline|
|visibility|hidden|
|visibility|locked|

```json
    "string"
  ],

    "string"
  ],
  "createdAt": [
    "string"
  ],
  "duration": [
    0
  ],
  "fileCreatedAt": [
    "string"
  ],

  ],

      "string",
      "string"
    ]

    "string"

  ]
}
```

<h1 id="immich-workflows">Workflows</h1>

A workflow is a set of actions that run whenever a triggering event occurs. Workflows also can include filters to further limit execution.

## List all workflows

<a id="opIdsearchWorkflows"></a>

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
```

|logging|query|boolean|false|Workflow logs run results|

```bash
  }'
```

`POST /workflows`

## Update a workflow

<a id="opIdupdateWorkflow"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:2283/api/workflows/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "string",
    "enabled": true,
    "logging": true,
    "name": "string",
    "steps": [
      {
        "config": {
          "property1": null,
          "property2": null
        },
        "enabled": true,
        "method": "string"
      }
    ],
    "trigger": "AssetCreate"
  }'
```

`PUT /workflows/{id}`

Update the information of a specific workflow by its ID. This endpoint can be used to update the workflow name, description, trigger type, filters and actions order, etc.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "string",
  "enabled": true,
  "logging": true,
  "name": "string",
  "steps": [
    {
      "config": {
        "property1": null,
        "property2": null
      },
      "enabled": true,
      "method": "string"
    }
  ],
  "trigger": "AssetCreate"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-workflow-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|none|
|body|body|[WorkflowUpdateDto](#schemaworkflowupdatedto)|true|none|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Workflow description|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|Workflow enabled|
|» logging|body|boolean|false|Workflow logs run results|
|» name|body|string \| null|false|Workflow name|
|» steps|body|[[WorkflowStepDto](#schemaworkflowstepdto)]|false|none|
|» trigger|body|[WorkflowTrigger](#schemaworkflowtrigger)|false|Workflow trigger type|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» trigger|AssetCreate|
|» trigger|AssetMetadataExtraction|
|» trigger|AssetOcrExtraction|
|» trigger|AssetTagged|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "createdAt": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "enabled": true,
  "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "logging": true,
  "name": "string",
  "steps": [
    {
      "config": {
        "property1": null,
        "property2": null
      },
      "enabled": true,
      "method": "string"
    }
  ],
  "trigger": "AssetCreate",
  "updatedAt": "string"
}
```

|200|OK||[WorkflowResponseDto](#schemaworkflowresponsedto)|

|longitude|number(double)|false|none|Longitude coordinate|

This is the authoritative timestamp for chronological sorting within timeline groups. Combined with timezone data, this can be used to determine the exact moment the photo was taken.|
|fileModifiedAt|string(date-time)|true|none|The UTC timestamp when the file was last modified on the filesystem. This reflects the last time the physical file was changed, which may be different from when the photo was originally taken.|

|livePhotoVideoId|string \| null|false|none|Live photo video ID|
|localDateTime|string(date-time)|true|none|The local date and time when the photo/video was taken, derived from EXIF metadata. This represents the photographer's local time regardless of timezone, stored as a timezone-agnostic timestamp. Used for timeline grouping by "local" days and months.|
|originalFileName|string|true|none|Original file name|
|originalMimeType|string|false|none|Original MIME type|
|originalPath|string|true|none|Original file path|

|stack|object \| null|false|none|none|
|tags|[[TagResponseDto](#schematagresponsedto)]|false|none|none|
|thumbhash|string \| null|true|none|Thumbhash for thumbnail generation (base64) also used as the c query param for thumbnail cache busting.|
|type|[AssetTypeEnum](#schemaassettypeenum)|true|none|Asset type|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|none|The UTC timestamp when the asset record was last updated in the database. This is automatically maintained by the database and reflects when any field in the asset was last modified.|

|stack|[[string]]|false|none|Array of stack information as [stackId, assetCount] tuples (null for non-stacked assets)|
|thumbhash|[string \| null]|true|none|Array of BlurHash strings for generating asset previews (base64 encoded)|
